assertions.assertion: Identifies Data Protection key ring as the root cause — each instance generates its own keys
assertions.rationale: It correctly identifies the per-instance Data Protection key ring as the cause of decryption failures across nodes.

assertions.assertion: Recommends configuring a shared key store (e.g., PersistKeysToDbContext, PersistKeysToAzureBlobStorage, or Redis)
assertions.rationale: It shows PersistKeysToDbContext, Redis, and Azure Blob Storage options with SetApplicationName.

assertions.assertion: Recommends server-side sessions with a shared store (AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions) instead of in-memory sessions
assertions.rationale: It mentions backing distributed sessions/caches with a shared store generally but never recommends BFF server-side sessions via AddEntityFrameworkServerSideSessions.

assertions.assertion: Shows code for AddDataProtection() with a persistent key store
assertions.rationale: It provides AddDataProtection().PersistKeysTo...() code with persistent backends.
